props.title: Signet Jam
props.description: Signet Jam is a weekly jam night at one Denver taproom on a Sunday or Monday, run by a professional house band with a sign-up sheet. We start with twelve weeks, and then we both decide whether to keep going.
props.ogImageAlt: A card reading A Weekly Jam Night: a professional house band and a sign-up sheet, Sunday or Monday.

<style>
/* Icons: one sprite (below), line icons on the 24 grid, brass, 1.5 stroke. */
.jam-ico { display: block; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- 01 hero */
.jam-hero { padding-top: var(--space-4); padding-bottom: var(--space-5); }
.jam-hero__grid { display: grid; gap: var(--space-4); align-items: center; }
.jam-hero .lede { max-width: 36rem; font-size: 1.0625rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; }
/* The sign-up sheet, half full. Drawn, not photographed: the one image on
   the page, in the palette, and it is the object the night runs on. Brass is
   spent on the signatures. */
.jam-sheet { width: 100%; max-width: 19rem; }
.jam-sheet svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
.jam-sheet__paper { fill: var(--paper-sunk); stroke: var(--rule-strong); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.jam-sheet__rule { stroke: var(--rule-strong); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.jam-sheet__line { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.jam-sheet__num { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; fill: var(--ink-faint); }
.jam-sheet__head { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 72%; font-size: 22px; text-transform: uppercase; fill: var(--ink); }
.jam-sheet__sig { fill: none; stroke: var(--brass); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .jam-hero__grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 0.75fr); }
  .jam-sheet { justify-self: end; max-width: 21rem; }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------- 02 what it does (points) */
.jam-points { margin-top: var(--space-4); display: grid; gap: 1px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--rule); }
.jam-point { background: var(--paper); padding: 1.5rem; }
.jam-point .jam-ico { width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; color: var(--brass); }
.jam-point h3 { margin-top: 1rem; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--ink); }
.jam-point p { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-soft); }
@media (min-width: 760px) { .jam-points { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- 03 the deal */
.jam-deal .prose { margin-top: 1rem; }
.jam-ledger { margin-top: var(--space-4); display: grid; gap: 1px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--rule); }
.jam-ledger__col { padding: 1.75rem; background: var(--paper); }
.jam-ledger__col .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
.jam-ledger__row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 0.85rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.jam-ledger__row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
.jam-ledger__row .jam-ico { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; margin-top: 0.15rem; color: var(--brass); }
.jam-ledger__row dt { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink); }
.jam-ledger__row dd { margin-top: 0.2rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-faint); }
.jam-closing { display: grid; gap: var(--space-2); align-items: center; margin-top: var(--space-4); padding-top: var(--space-3); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.jam-figure {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-stretch: 72%;
  font-size: clamp(4rem, 3rem + 4vw, 6.5rem);
  line-height: 0.85;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.jam-figure small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: var(--track-caps);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-faint);
}
.jam-closing__line { font-size: clamp(1.375rem, 1.1rem + 1.2vw, 2rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--ink); max-width: 18ch; text-wrap: balance; }
.jam-closing__note { margin-top: 0.75rem; max-width: 34rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-soft); }
@media (min-width: 760px) {
  .jam-ledger { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .jam-closing { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-4); }
}

/* ----------------------------------------------------------- 04 the night */
.jam-steps { list-style: none; margin: var(--space-4) 0 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.jam-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.25rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.jam-step__num {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-weight: 800;
  font-stretch: 72%;
  font-size: 2.25rem;
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--brass);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.jam-step h3 { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--ink); }
.jam-step p { margin-top: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 40rem; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------ 05 who's running it */
.jam-host { display: grid; gap: var(--space-3); margin-top: var(--space-4); }
.jam-host__ico { width: 5.5rem; height: 5.5rem; color: var(--brass); }
.jam-host__text { max-width: 40rem; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.jam-host__text + .jam-host__text { margin-top: 1rem; }
.jam-host .wordmark { display: block; margin-top: var(--space-3); color: var(--ink-faint); }
@media (min-width: 760px) { .jam-host { grid-template-columns: 8rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-4); } }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ 06 questions */
.jam-questions .faq-row dd { max-width: 44rem; }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- 07 close */
.jam-close .h2 { max-width: 14ch; }
.jam-close .lede { max-width: 32rem; }

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- motion */
.jam-motion .jam-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); transition: opacity 0.8s ease, transform 0.8s ease; }
.jam-motion .jam-reveal.is-in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .jam-motion .jam-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; }
}
</style>

Signet Jam

A weekly jam night

You know how quiet a taproom can get on a Sunday or Monday. Signet Jam is a live music night at your place every week, with a professional house band and a sign-up sheet. Musicians from around Denver put their names on the sheet, then get up and play a few songs with the band. Signet runs the night, and your staff runs the bar the way it always does.

Book a 30-minute call hello@signetartists.com

The business case

What a jam does for a taproom

Musicians are your first customers.

Every musician who signs the sheet is one more person through your door on a slow night. They'll often have a drink at your bar while they wait for their turn to play.

Same night, every week.

It's the same night and the same band every week, so anyone who comes once knows when to come back.

A featured act once a month.

Once a month, an act with its own following plays the second set, which can bring a whole new crowd through your door.

A video clip a week for your social accounts.

Every week we cut a clip from the night and send it to you ready to post, with your venue tagged.

The deal

What it costs the venue, and what Signet brings

You cover a fee and a few things you already have, and we bring everything else.

The venue covers

A fee.
In the early weeks it goes into marketing and promotion for the night.
A corner of the floor for the band.
We don't need a stage.
Your staff for the night.
Your normal crew can run the bar as usual.
A closet for our gear.
We just need somewhere to keep our amps and drums between nights.
One post a week from your accounts.
We send you the clip, ready to go.
A drink for the band.
We just ask for one round for the house band each week.

Signet brings

The house band.
These are professional musicians who play around Denver every week.
The host.
The host runs the sign-up sheet, picks the songs and decides who plays on what.
The sign-up sheet and the lineup.
We keep track of who plays next, on which songs and for how long.
The gear.
We'll bring all of the band's gear, so you don't need to buy or rent anything.
A featured act every month.
We'll find and book the act for you.
A clip every week, cut and ready to post.
We film the night so you don't have to.
The musicians.
They come from around Denver, on a night most of them have off.

12weeks

We'll start with twelve weeks, and then we both decide.

That's the whole commitment. At week twelve we sit down together, look at how the nights went, and decide whether it continues and on what terms.

A typical jam night

How the night runs

  1. 01

    The house band opens with a set.

    The band plays a full set before anyone from the sheet comes up.

  2. 02

    Musicians sign the sheet at the bar.

    The host calls them up in order, and each one plays a few songs they already know.

  3. 03

    Once a month, a featured act plays the second set.

    It's a great night to tell your regulars about.

  4. 04

    The band closes the night.

    Then the band packs the gear back into your closet until next week.

  5. 05

    You get the clip.

    We'll send it over once it's edited, so you have something to post that week.

Who's running it

Signet Jam is run by a seasoned, connected professional musician. The host plays bass for a living, upright and electric, in bands around Denver, and before that built a company to 180 people and sold it.

Signet Artists delivers live entertainment for private events in Denver, Colorado and surrounding areas.

Signet Artists

Questions

What taproom owners ask about a jam night

Is there a fee?
Yes. We'll go over the number on the call.
Do we need a stage?
No.
How loud is it?
It's a band with a drummer, so it's as loud as a band in a bar. The host keeps the volume in check from the floor. If your space has a limit, or close neighbors, tell us on the call and we'll plan around it.
Who gets to sit in?
Any musician who signs the sheet.
What if only a few people sign up the first week?
The house band plays a full night whether the sheet has three names on it or twenty. That's also why the trial is twelve weeks. Neither of us has to judge it on the first night.
Why Sunday or Monday?
They're usually your slowest nights, and they're the nights most musicians have off, since the paid gigs tend to be on Fridays and Saturdays. If a different night is your slow one, tell us.

We're looking for one taproom for a Sunday or Monday night.

Tell us which night is your slow one, and we'll walk you through how it would run at your place.

Book a 30-minute call hello@signetartists.com

 /* Fade up on enter, once. A scroll check rather than an

 var ticking = false;
 function check() {

 pending = pending.filter(function (el) {
 if (el.getBoundingClientRect().top < line) { el.classList.add('is-in'); return false; }
 return true;
 });
 if (!pending.length) {

 function onScroll() {
 if (!ticking) { ticking = true; window.requestAnimationFrame(check); }
 }
